title: Keep Going
style: Close and spoken, one person on a bad phone line. Spoken English of a young working woman, not literary, not sitcom. Asides: lower, quicker, turned away from the line. Translated from the Swedish draft 7 (episod-1.json, v40), 2026-10-23; voices chosen 2026-10-26, Vega recast as Jessica 2026-10-29; her "Now." after each question she asks for a stop (x-now) added 2026-10-29; s0-1's "It's not the lights." after a longer pause and slower, as it dawns on her (Henric 2026-10-29), from a new take put into the v47 one. The count under her breath (s2-count, s2-3) laid one number a second from the v45 takes, 1.2 s after thirty (v49, Henric 29/10: too fast at the start, too slow at the end). s0-2: about 4 s of silence after "I'm keeping up instead.", so it sinks in (v50, Henric 29/10: "Lång paus efteråt"), 3.6 s laid into the v45 take at 11.28 s where it was 0.4; the hiss there eases to none 18.1 s in (14.5 before), still at "can you hear this". A new take of s0-2 needs the same pause laid in.

voiceNotes.vega: Jessica, Soft and Demure (American, a professional clone), eleven_v4, stability 0.3, no overall tag (Henric 2026-10-29: 'Som provet'). Her recording carries a hiss, taken by the local filter (denoise: render_glimt.py DENOISE, Henric's nr=12).
voiceNotes.snackan: Rowan (British, his own accent), eleven_v3, no tags, stability 1.0 so it stays flat (Henric 2026-10-26). Played through the earpiece filter named under snackaFilter (glimt/herside.js).

lines.s0-1:
[mutters to herself, quick and low] There it is again. Right at the edge.

It's the lights. It's always the lights.

[pause] [slowly, realising] It's not the lights.

[quick and low] Okay, now. Do it now.
lines.s0-2:
[calling out, unsure] Hello? [louder] Hello! [urgent] Wait!

[flustered, quick] No, no, no, don't wait! Sorry. Keep going. Don't disappear. When you stand still, you disappear on me. I'm keeping up instead.

I don't know who you are. I don't even know if you can hear this. I can't hear anything from you. Not a sound. I just get glimpses. A shape at the edge. And bits of your world.

But I have thought about this. About you.
lines.s0-ask1:
So here's what we are gonna do. I will ask you a question and then say now. If the answer is yes, you stop for a couple of seconds. If it is no, you keep going.

[pause] [calm, slowly, serious] Ok. Can you see me?
lines.x-stod: [steady, clear] You'd already disappeared when I asked. Keep going a bit, then I'll ask again.
lines.s0-go1: [steady, clear] ...There, I've lost you. Now go.
lines.x-ga-igen: [steady, clear] I can't see you when you stand still. Go.
lines.s0-yes1-a: [mutters to herself, quick and low] What? That can't be right. You can't see me. You can't.
lines.s0-yes1-b: You just wanted to answer. Fine. Once more, then. [pause] Can you hear me?
lines.s0-no1: [dry] No. Didn't think so. [pause] One more thing. [pause] Can you hear me?
lines.s0-yes2:
[stunned] You heard me. I didn't think I'd get this far.

[softly] I see you.

[quietly] And you hear me.
lines.s0-no2: No. No, of course not. You're steps, not ears. [quietly] I'll talk anyway. Never stopped me before.
lines.s1-walk:
[calmly] There. You're clear now.

You're walking. Like someone who's allowed to go wherever they like.
lines.s1-run:
[calmly] There. You're clear now.

You're running. Nobody runs here. It's not banned. Nobody's got anything to run to, that's all.
lines.s1-2:
Go however you like. If you have to stop, stop. Your road comes before mine.

I'm walking too. Everyone does, after the shift. Round the loop, forty minutes. "Health-promoting movement," it says on the wall. [deadpan] We're very healthy.

I don't know anything about you, so I'll ask. Same as before: if it's yes, you stop until I say go. It's safe here, I'm just doing my round.
lines.s1-self: [mutters to herself, quick and low] Ask something real this time. ...Come on.
lines.s1-q2: Are you alone? Out there, I mean.
lines.s1-go: [steady, clear] There. Got it. Now go.
lines.s1-q2-yes: Me too. Even with forty of us on the loop. [chuckles] It's not the same.
lines.s1-q2-no: No? [pause] So you've got someone besides me. [dry] I'll have to share.
lines.s1-3:
They know how we walk. Every step. Too slow, they know. Wrong way, they know. [pause] You're not on any of their lists.

But here you are anyway. [pause] And now I've got an idea. A stupid one.
lines.s2-1:
Here's the thing. I'm walking along talking out loud to someone who isn't there, and nobody's said a word. Not one, since you came.

So I'm going to try something. Something small. Keep going, if you can.
lines.s2-2:
I'm standing still.

[whispers] Half a minute with no steps, then they want to know what you're up to. I'm counting.
lines.s2-count: [whispers, under her breath, one number a second] ...twelve, thirteen, fourteen, fifteen, sixteen, seventeen, eighteen, nineteen, twenty, twenty-one, twenty-two, twenty-three, twenty-four, twenty-five, twenty-six.
lines.s2-count-stop: [whispers, urgent] ...go. Or they'll start counting me.
lines.s2-3: [whispers] ...twenty-seven. Twenty-eight. Twenty-nine. Thirty. [short pause] Thirty-one. [short pause] Thirty-two.
lines.s2-4:
[amazed] They're not asking. You're moving, and they think it's me.

[laughs] Four years I've walked this loop, same direction. And now I'm standing here like a post. Best thing I've done since I got here.

Now one more thing. Just keep going.
lines.s2-self: [mutters to herself, quick and low] Three metres. It's only three metres.
lines.s2-5: I've stepped off the gravel. You don't step off the gravel. There's trees here, three metres in. I've walked past them a thousand times.
lines.s2-6: It's plastic. [short pause] The tree's plastic. I knew that. [pause] I'm patting it anyway.
lines.s2-ask: Stop for a bit, if you can. Stand here with me.
lines.s2-lamp-plea2: [whispers, pleading] Please... I can't move from here till you do. Go.
lines.s2-lamp-mine: [quietly] I asked you to stop, and forgot I was still walking.
lines.s2-lamp-1:
[exhales] That was the lamp. It came on when you stopped. [pause] I've never seen it lit before. [deadpan] It's pretty, actually.

You move, I'm hidden. ... Sounds like something you'd scratch into a wall.
lines.s2-lamp-2: And you stopped when I asked. [short pause] You hear me.
lines.s2-no: No? [chuckles] No. Probably for the best. I don't know what happens if you stand still while I'm out here. I don't think I want to find out tonight.
lines.s3-1: [exhales] I'm sitting down now. Under the plastic tree. And when I sit still, I see more of you. Not you, you're still just a shape. What's around you.
lines.s3-dark:
It's dark where you are. Here it's always evening, but never dark. They say it's calming.

And above you it just goes on. All the way up.
lines.s3-light:
It's light where you are. It's so bright at the edges. Here it's always evening. They say it's calming.

Your sky's lit all the way up. We've got a lamp called Daylight. It does its best.
lines.s3-rain: And it's raining where you are. It's like static over everything. Here we drink the same water over and over. Where you are it's just falling. Straight down. All of it.
lines.s3-dry: And it's dry where you are. It never rains here. That would be a waste.
lines.s3-bro: A bridge. It's blurry, like a pencil line. [pause] We've got a bridge here too. It goes over nothing. [pause] Someone drew the bridge and forgot the river.
lines.s3-vatten: Water. It's glinting. [pause] We've got water here too. Sounds like water, anyway. I have found the speaker.
lines.s3-skog: Woods. Thick ones. [pause] We've got woods here too, right at the back. Flat as a painting, but they rustle. They got that bit right.
lines.s3-berg: A hill. [pause] We've got a hill here too. You're not allowed up it. I don't think it'd hold.
lines.s3-kyrkogard: A graveyard. [pause] We've got a graveyard here too. No graves. Someone must have thought it looked nice.
lines.s4-1: [quietly] That's the bell. The loop's closing.
lines.s4-self: [mutters to herself, quick and low] Up. Up, up.
lines.s4-2: [hurried] In a minute the whole shift comes around the corner, and I'm sitting under a tree. Go now, if you can. Don't stop. Not now.
lines.s4-ok: [exhales] On the gravel. A worker on her round, that's all they see. [deadpan] I've stood like a post, patted a tree and sat on the ground. And nobody saw a thing.
lines.s4-ok-lamp: [exhales] On the gravel. A worker on her round, that's all they see. [deadpan] I've stood like a post, patted a tree and sat on the ground. The lamp caught one out of three. Not bad, for a first time.
lines.s4-lamp-2: [quietly] I made it. But it's been logged. A deviation. I'll be hearing about that.
lines.s4-back: You're on your way back. I can tell, you're going straight now. [deadpan] I just go round. Same thing, according to the wall.
lines.s4-onward: You're heading away from where you started. Straight out. [pause] I can't do that. But I can watch.
lines.s4-yes:
I don't know what you are. But you hear me, and you stopped when I asked. That's more than I know about most people here.

I've seen you before, you know. Out at the edge. Lots of times. Just a shape, never anything more. [pause] Tonight's the first time you've... answered.

So you're Shape. That's what I've been calling you in my head. [pause] It'll do.

I'm Vega. In case you were wondering.
lines.s4-never-1:
I don't know what you are. A glitch in their numbers, maybe. Or someone out there who's got no idea what they did tonight.

I'll ask one more time, then I'll give up. If you hear me: stop.
lines.s4-never-yes-2:
[laughs] All night! You've heard me all night. And I've been going on about plastic trees.

I've seen you before, you know. Out at the edge, lots of times. Just a shape. So you're Shape. It'll do. I'm Vega. In case you were wondering.
lines.s4-never-no:
No. Okay. Then you're steps. [pause] I've been hiding in them all night, so I'm not complaining.

I've seen you out at the edge before. Just a shape. I'll call you Shape anyway. I'm Vega, if anyone's wondering.
lines.s4-all:
There are people here who whisper. By the presses, where it's loudest. They stop when I come over. I've never been able to go where they go.

[short pause] Maybe now I can.

And from now on, whenever I get a bit of your sky, I'm going to look for a star. [pause] Just one.

Come back out. If you want. I'll manage otherwise, I have for a long time. But come.
lines.r-hjalp: Vega. You are stationary. Do you need assistance?

harda.prompt: One person in hard-soled shoes walking on a gravel path with firm, even, confident steps, close-up recording, dry, no background noise, no voices, no music
